kind: literature and source inspection, no new experiment
checked_scope: 32 paper records, 103 pre-existing research findings; original findings and gates preserved

primary_sources.confirmed: Query-to-query attention restriction is removed for imputation; this is not a graph-classification result.
Per-feature inducing Gather reads context and query nodes. Labels enter before compression; severe missing-feature benefit is not established here.
Longer walks and context-visited filtering are existing methods, with runtime tradeoffs. Fully featureless graphs are evaluated; our severe-missing protocol is not evaluated here.
Structure-conditioned mixture and analytic first-GNN-layer marginal processing. Boundary rank result is restricted to fixed linear channel-wise propagation.
Local probabilistic circuits do not resolve global graph joint validity automatically.

conclusions.confirmed_code_restriction: Base sequence attention keys/values are limited to eval_pos context nodes.
conclusions.residual_access: Own feature residuals and graph adapter paths remain. Do not infer complete invisibility of unlabeled observations.
conclusions.untested_causal_claim: This restriction has not been identified as the cause of previous failures.
conclusions.novelty: No claim of established novelty or solved failure. Existing all-node attention and query interactions are direct baselines.
